# sendgrid_subuser (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing SendGrid subuser by username.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendgrid_subuser" "app" {
  username = "my_app_subuser"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) The subuser's username.

### Read-Only

- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether this subuser is disabled.
- `email` (String) The subuser's email address.
- `id` (String) The subuser's numeric user ID.
- `region` (String) The region this subuser is assigned to.
